app.name: VibeClassAgent
app.tagline: Silent classroom recorder and lesson summarizer

welcome.need_setup: No config yet. Run /doctor fix to create it.

menu.title: Common actions
menu.hint: Type a number, or use the / commands directly (for scripting and troubleshooting)
menu.5: Recording test (10 s, verifies screen + mic)
menu.9: Run for real (records by the schedule)

cmd.help_dev_section: The following are for developers (scripting / troubleshooting)
cmd.help_footer: Tip: the same features work as `vca <subcommand>` for scheduled tasks.
cmd.jobs: List every job and its state
cmd.process: Process pending jobs (transcribe → extract → document → push)
cmd.doctor: Environment check; add fix to create missing dirs/config
cmd.paths: Show or change data & config locations (defaults next to the program, never on C:)
cmd.model: Show or pick the extraction model (can fetch the list from the API)
cmd.record: Recording status; record start / stop for manual control
cmd.audio: Probe WASAPI audio endpoints (system sound / microphone)
cmd.record_test: 10-second recording smoke test (with screenshots and muxing)
cmd.transcribe_test: Transcribe the last recording as a smoke test
cmd.e2e: End-to-end: record 15s and run the whole pipeline (documents + push dry run)
cmd.clean: Preview expired cleanup; add run to actually delete
cmd.unknown: Unknown command {cmd}. Type /help for the full list.
cmd.only_commands: This only accepts commands. Type /help, or /status for the current state.
cmd.no_terminal: Cannot start interactive input ({err}). Use subcommands instead: vca --help

doctor.title: Environment check

doctor.legend: Legend: [SKIP] means it is optional (a fallback exists); [MISS] needs attention.

hint.fetch_deps: Run scripts/fetch-deps.py to fetch runtime components
hint.env_key: Credentials live in environment variables, never in config files

push.setup_title: Configure push channel (where the lesson report is delivered)
push.skipped: Skipped. Pick "2 Configure push" in the main menu whenever you like.
push.ask_group: target group number (the QQ group the bot is in):
push.write_failed: Write failed — the config was NOT saved. Please send me the error above.
push.secret_saved: credentials written to {p} (never committed; delete it to reconfigure)
push.verify_hint: Next: pick "6 Process pending jobs" in the main menu to run once and see whether the message arrives; if not, /status shows the exact error.
push.test_title: Push connectivity test (sends one message, skips the whole recording flow)
push.test_no_provider: No push channel configured yet. Set push.provider in settings.yaml, or pick "2 Configure push" in the main menu.
push.test_ok: sent (message id = {id}). Check the chat: you should see a "VibeClassAgent push test" message.

sched.title: Class plan (decides which lessons get recorded)
sched.empty: The class plan is empty — import or fill one first, otherwise the program cannot know what to record.
sched.m_edit: How to edit this file by hand
sched.template_hint: Save the text above as .csv (Excel makes it easier), then use "2 Import from CSV".
sched.edit_hint: Open {p} in Notepad and edit directly — the file documents every field. Then pick "7 View status" to confirm.
